- Overall performance: Revenue after eliminations is $12.24 billion with a gross margin of 51.2% and EBITDA margin of 34.9%.
- The company that contributes most to revenue is Wipro Consumer Care International with $7.16 billion, while the company that needs attention is Wipro Consumer Care India with an EBITDA margin of 17.5%, significantly lower than the overall EBITDA margin.
- Margins are at 51.2% for gross margin and 34.9% for EBITDA margin, indicating a relatively stable profitability.
- Working capital as of 2026-07-01 is managed with 147 days of DSO and 409 days of DPO.
